prompt: In a vibrant anime style illustration, the scene unfolds within a chaotic restaurant kitchen. On the far left stands a tall chef in a pristine white hat, his arms crossed tightly over his chest while he glares sternly at a junior cook in a blue apron who is frantically chopping carrots on a wooden board. Next to the junior cook sits a small ginger cat perched precariously on a stack of dirty plates, its tail twitching with curiosity as it watches a silver ladle being handed from a woman in a pink headscarf to a man with thick glasses who is stirring a large pot of bubbling stew in the center of the room. To the right of the central stove, a delivery boy in a yellow helmet leans against the wall, holding a clipboard and pointing urgently at a digital clock mounted high above the pass-through window. A brown dog lies sleeping peacefully under a stainless steel table near the delivery boy, completely oblivious to the commotion. In the foreground, a waitress with short black hair looks anxiously at a customer in a green suit who is tapping his foot impatiently while waiting for his order. Behind them, a dishwasher in rubber gloves scrubs a glass plate vigorously, water splashing onto the floor where a mop bucket sits tipped over. A stray pigeon flies through an open window on the upper right, dropping a feather that lands on the shoulder of a sous chef in a striped shirt who is wiping sweat from his forehead. The head chef in the white hat continues to stare down the junior cook, creating a tense atmosphere amidst the culinary chaos. There is no fire visible in the scene, and there is no blood present anywhere in the kitchen. The composition captures the frantic energy of professional cooking through dynamic poses and expressive faces typical of the genre.
